question: Should this narrow two-file branch be selected as the canonical fix for the shared nack idempotency issue?
rationale: This PR and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/104928 are both technically correct and proof-positive, so selecting and crediting one overlapping contribution requires maintainer coordination rather than automated repair.

options.title: Select this narrow branch
options.body: Land this focused implementation, then close https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/104928 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/105009 as redundant or inferior candidates.

options.title: Select the scripted branch
options.body: Land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/104928 only if maintainers intentionally want its standalone verification script as a maintained repository surface.

recommendation.title: Select this narrow branch
recommendation.body: Land this focused implementation, then close https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/104928 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/105009 as redundant or inferior candidates.
